implementation.name: Pooyan (Analogue Pocket, opengateware)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 40 HDL source files (4 systemverilog, 13 verilog, 23 vhdl). There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: this openFPGA core ships 4 MRA files of its own; 1 setnames resolved exactly to a MAME 0.288 machine and 2 through MAME's own cloneof relation, giving 1 distinct machine_id rows. 1 did not resolve (absent-from-mame-0288: 1). license_id omitted: https://github.com/opengateware/arcade-pooyan/blob/master/LICENSE is the verbatim GNU GPL version 3 text, but the repository states no version scope, and GPL's only-vs-or-later distinction comes from the grant, not the licence text. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 40 source files (4 systemverilog, 13 verilog, 23 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify. Core identity read from the openFPGA manifest pkg/pocket/Cores/boogermann.pooyan/core.json in the repository, which declares core identifier boogermann.pooyan.
